answer: Every newcomer enters through an inlet, one established member's entry circle. Admission needs a chain of quill introductions, each link one established member vouching for the next, good for one epoch only. The inlet's zenith is its admission count; the next applicant needs a chain as long as the zenith plus one, every link distinct. Forging 1,000 puppets through one inlet needs 500,500 introductions at $10 each, $5,005,000; the 1,000th alone needs 1,000. Splitting needs fresh established hosts, who are scarce. One honest newcomer presents a single quill and pays $10.
